label: EnGenius ECS1528P (24x 1G PoE+, 240 W, 4x SFP+)
description: EnGenius Cloud ECS1528P layer 2+ PoE switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T 802.3af/at PoE+ RJ45 (240 W budget), 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 128 Gbps switching capacity, 16K MAC, 19-inch 1U.

poe.note: 240 W total across ports 1-24, each 802.3af/at (15.4 W / 30 W). The datasheet quotes the budget and the per-port standard but never the pair: 24 x 30 W = 720 W of port capability behind a 240 W supply, so the box powers 8 ports at a full 30 W, or all 24 at 10 W average. Modelled at 30 W a port with a 240 W budget - the budget, not the port, is the binding limit. Adds PoE Extended Mode (250 m cabling), PD Lifeguard (auto-reboot of a failed camera) and Continuous PoE (no power interruption across a firmware upgrade).

fabric.note: Vendor figure 128 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of 24x 1G plus 4x 10G.

notes: Datasheet DS_Cloud_ECS1528P v1.3 (06032024): 24x 10/100/1000 Mbps ports, 4x SFP+ ports, 128 Gbps, 512 MB SDRAM, 128 MB flash, PoE capable ports 1-24 (802.3af/at), 240 W budget, 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz, 16K MAC, 10K jumbo frame, 3.81 kg, 440 x 260 x 44 mm. Management is EnGenius Cloud (zero-touch provisioning), the local web GUI (HTTP/HTTPS over IPv4 and IPv6) and a CLI reached over SSH/Telnet/TFTP config backup; SNMP v1/v2c/v3 with RMON 1,2,3,9 is supported. Layer 3 is static routing only: 63 IPv4 and 21 IPv6 static routes, a 192-entry ARP table and up to 20 IPv6 addresses on the box - no OSPF and no BGP, which is why this is modelled as l3-forward without a routing engine. L2 set: 802.1D/w/s spanning tree, 802.1Q tagging with port-based and protocol-based VLANs, 802.3ad link aggregation, IGMP and MLD snooping, voice VLAN, 802.1X with RADIUS, MAC/IP ACLs and storm control, 8 QoS queues. Operating 0-50 C, 5-95% RH non-condensing, 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz, 2-year warranty. Firmware: the ECS15XX-25XX image is shared across the ECS15xx and ECS25xx classes - the download table on the model pages lists ECS15XX-25XX_firmware_1.2.136-197.imag dated 16 July 2026 as the current build, with 1.2.130-193 (27 May 2026) and 1.2.125-192 (12 February 2026) beneath it. Sources: https://www.engeniustech.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/DS_Cloud_ECS1528P_v1.3.pdf and https://www.engeniustech.com/eu/products/network-switches/ecs1528p/ (comparison table: 24 gigabit ports, 4x SFP+, ports 1-24 802.3af/at, 240 W, 128 Gbps, 16K MAC, 440 x 260 x 44 mm).
